# astscan 0.1.0

`astscan` runs multiple ast-grep rules in one scan and prints structured
matches for lint and code search tools. Rust callers can embed
`astscan-core` to scan in-memory source. Both support structural Cypher
queries and bundle 33 grammars, including MoonBit, Zig, TOML, SQL, and XML.

```sh
cargo install astscan --version 0.1.0 --locked
cat > rules.yml <<'YAML'
id: log-call
language: JavaScript
severity: warning
rule:
  pattern: console.log($ARG)
YAML
printf 'console.log("hello");\n' > main.js
astscan scan --rule rules.yml --json=stream --fail-on-skipped -- main.js
```

Expect a single JSON match for `log-call` and an exit code of 0. If an input
could not be scanned, the CLI reports the reason on stderr and
`--fail-on-skipped` exits 2.

- [CLI crate](https://crates.io/crates/astscan/0.1.0)
- [Rust library](https://crates.io/crates/astscan-core/0.1.0)

- [Structural Cypher queries](https://github.com/mizchi/astscan#cypher-queries)
